'''Jürgen Neukirch''' (24 July 1937 – 5 February 1997<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.numbertheory.org/ntw/additions2.html |title=New Listings, Number Theory Web: 2 October 1996-{{Sic|hide=y|23|th}} July 1997 |access-date=17 May 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080509133724/http://www.numbertheory.org/ntw/additions2.html |archive-date=9 May 2008 |url-status=dead }}</ref>) was a German [[mathematician]] known for his work on [[algebraic number theory]].

==Education and career==
Neukirch received his diploma in mathematics in 1964 from the [[University of Bonn]]. For his Ph.D. thesis, written under the direction of [[Wolfgang Krull]], he was awarded in 1965 the [[Felix-Hausdorff-Gedächtnis-Preis]]. He completed his [[habilitation]] one year later. From 1967 to 1969 he was guest professor at [[Queen's University at Kingston|Queen's University]] in [[Kingston, Ontario]] and at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in [[Cambridge, Massachusetts]], after which he was a professor in Bonn. In 1971 he became a professor at the [[University of Regensburg]].<ref>[http://www.uni-regensburg.de/Universitaet/RUZ/archiv/ruz-9703/broecker.htm U-Mail, Regensburger Universitätszeitung von 1999 – 2009] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090202134509/http://www.uni-regensburg.de/Universitaet/RUZ/archiv/ruz-9703/broecker.htm |date=2 February 2009 }}</ref>

==Contributions==
He is known for his work on the [[embedding problem]] in algebraic number theory, the [[Báyer–Neukirch theorem]] on [[special values of L-functions]], arithmetic Riemann existence theorems and the [[Neukirch–Uchida theorem]] in birational [[anabelian geometry]]. He gave a simple description of the reciprocity maps in [[Local class field theory|local]] and global [[class field theory]].

==Books==
Neukirch wrote three books on [[class field theory]], [[algebraic number theory]], and the [[cohomology]] of number fields:
*{{cite book | first=Jürgen | last=Neukirch | title=Class Field Theory | volume=280 | series=Grundlehren der Mathematischen Wissenschaften | location=Berlin | publisher=[[Springer-Verlag]] | year=1986 | isbn=3-540-15251-2 }}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Hazewinkel, Michiel|author-link=Hazewinkel, Michiel|title=Review: ''Class field theory'', by Jürgen Neukirch; ''Local class field theory'', by Kenkichi Iwasawa|journal=Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society |series=New Series|year=1989|volume=21|issue=1|pages=95–101|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1989-21-01/S0273-0979-1989-15772-8/|doi=10.1090/s0273-0979-1989-15772-8|doi-access=free}}</ref> 
*{{cite book | first=Jürgen | last=Neukirch | title=Algebraic Number Theory | volume=322 | series=Grundlehren der Mathematischen Wissenschaften | publisher=[[Springer-Verlag]] | year=1999 | isbn=978-3-540-65399-8 | zbl=0956.11021 }}
*{{cite book | title=Cohomology of Number Fields | volume=323 | series=Grundlehren der Mathematischen Wissenschaften | first1=Jürgen | last1=Neukirch | first2=Alexander | last2=Schmidt | first3=Kay | last3=Wingberg | edition=2nd | publisher=[[Springer-Verlag]] | year=2008 | isbn=978-3-540-37888-4 | zbl=1136.11001 }}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Gouvêa, Fernando Q.|author-link= Fernando Q. Gouvêa |title=Review: ''Cohomology of number theory'', by Jürgen Neukirch, Alexander Schmidt, and Kay Wingberg|journal=Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society |series=New Series|year=2002|volume=39|issue=1|pages=101–107|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/2002-39-01/S0273-0979-01-00924-7/ | doi = 10.1090/S0273-0979-01-00924-7|doi-access=free}}</ref>
*{{cite book | first=Jürgen | last=Neukirch | title=Class Field Theory — The Bonn Lectures | publisher=Springer | year=2013 | isbn=978-3-642-35436-6 }}<ref>{{cite web|title=Review of ''Class Field Theory — The Bonn Lectures'' by Jürgen Neukirch|date=8 August 2013|website=MAA Reviews, Mathematical Association of America|author=Gouvêa, Fernando Q.|url=https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/class-field-theory-the-bonn-lectures|access-date=12 September 2018|archive-date=1 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221001072732/https://www.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/class-field-theory-the-bonn-lectures|url-status=dead}}</ref>
